channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: CA governor signs 'landmark' laws on youth use of social media and AI chatbots
item.description: They're aimed at protecting minors, but the rules are not universally supported.

item.title: Ukraine starts building a jet-powered drone with a range of over 1,000 kilometers
item.description: Ukraine has begun producing BARS strike drones in Europe, with German funding supporting systems offering longer range and heavier warheads.

item.title: Thrive Capital led VCs into pro sports ownership; Collaborative Fund just upped that play
item.description: Collaborative Fund just bought into D.C. United and its stadium, with firm founder Craig Shapiro pitching it as a way to showcase for the firm's startups.

item.title: Quote of the day by Telsa and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk: 'A manufacturing line is fundamentally thousands of times harder than the prototype' — an insight into the difficulties in scaling up from a concept to the finished product
item.description: Turning an idea into a mass-produced reality is much easier said than done

item.title: Jensen Huang explains why Nvidia will grow an astounding 70% next year
item.description: Nvidia has its finger in every pie, and sees another year of plenty in its future, Jensen Huang says. But, he insists, its deals are not circular.

item.title: 'I love this place; it's in my blood. Goosebumps'; John Ternus on how he felt when he learned he was becoming Apple CEO, and why AI may be the key to future Apple innovation
item.description: Apple chief John Ternus tells us how it feels to be CEO, what innovation looks like, and how excited he is about what comes next.

item.title: Mark Wahlberg is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and he wants to talk about your work, not his
item.description: Mark Wahlberg joins Bruce K. Lee at Disrupt to discuss investing, entrepreneurship, healthcare, wellness and building businesses.

item.title: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
item.description: A new feature coming to Slack will allow you to build interactive reports, polls, dashboards, presentations, microsites, and other tools directly inside a chat. With Slackforce Surfaces, you can describe to Slackbot what you need, and it will use AI to gather information from relevant conversations and connected apps, like Google Drive or Salesforce, to […]...

item.title: AMD Threadripper Halo Station is probably the world's most expensive desktop PC thanks to its 2.7TB memory and four AI GPUs — a GB300 rival likely to cost $150,000 with just 1 CPU
item.description: AMD’s Threadripper Halo Station combines massive memory, four AI accelerators and 96 CPU cores for demanding local AI workloads.

item.title: Anthropic caught scientists using Claude to further biological weapon research
item.description: Anthropic produced an extensive collection of case studies covering the ways its current AI models have been misused.
